HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.

5. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.

7. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.
   C. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.
   C. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.

9. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat External Security as rumours only.
   C. Say External Security never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing External Security.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   B. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The 4 th Generation of Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and conflict transformatio n at the global level. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan innovations and their adoption in other nations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
